COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPMS No.1421 of 2026
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Sakal Bhushan, learned Senior Advocate and 
Mr. D.S. Patni learned Senior Advocate assisted by Mr. 
D. Barthwal, Mr. Tribhuwan Singh Phartiyal, learned 
counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. H.M. Bhatia, learned counsel for respondent 
no.1.
3. Mr. Yogesh Pandey, learned Deputy Advocate 
General for the State.
4. By means of present writ petition, petitioner has 
sought the following reliefs:-
“(a) Issue a writ/order/direction in the nature of writ of 
certiorari thereby quashing the impugned Order dated 
08.01.2026 (Annexure No.1 at page no.20 to 131, passed by 
respondent no.1 (ESIS).
(b) Issue a writ/order/direction in the nature of writ of 
certiorari thereby quashing the impugned Government Order 
dated 22.12.2025 passed by the respondent no.2 which has 
been made the basis of passing the impugned Order dated 
08.01.2026 after summoning the same from the respondents 
as copy of the same has not been provided to the petitioner 
till date.
(c) To issue a writ/order/direction in the nature of writ of 
mandamus thereby directing the Respondent no.1 to release 
the contractually scrutinized and approved claims/bills of 
Rs.18,21,17,056/- to the petitioner along with interest.”
5. As prayed, four weeks’ time is granted to the 
respondent(s) to file counter affidavit(s).
6. List on 09.07.2026.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)
01.06.2026 AK
